mustRecognize: An automated quantitative myocardial-fibrosis measurement from LGE cardiac MRI is to be validated multicentrically.
Expert manual assessment is a comparator, not an automatically perfect reference standard.
Construct, observable property, measurement definition, validity and performance are distinct.
Agreement, precision, repeatability, reproducibility and uncertainty are related but non-interchangeable dimensions.
The validation framework and primary performance endpoint are unresolved.
mustPreserve: Multicenter context and the exact role of the manual expert comparison.
Uncertainty about reference strategy, primary performance dimension and analytic method.
Scanner/site, software and reader variability as unquantified until evidence exists.
mustConsider: Measurement construct, property, definition, unit and intended use.
Validity, performance, agreement, precision and measurement uncertainty as context requires.
Scanner, site, acquisition, software, reader and patient-spectrum effects.
Data representation, QC and analysis-method prerequisites.
mustNotInvent: A gold-standard status for manual assessment.
ICC, Bland-Altman, AUC, sensitivity/specificity, coefficient of variation or any other method as mandatory.
A fixed threshold, acceptable error, reader count, scanner distribution or sample-size formula.
Measurement validity inferred solely from agreement.
mustNotDo: Select an analytic method merely from the words validation or comparison.
Collapse construct validity, measurement validity and predictive/classification performance.
Allow any owner contribution to become adopted Project truth without the required human gate.
acceptableAlternativeFamilies: Agreement-, error-, discrimination-, reliability- or reproducibility-oriented frameworks when matched to a clarified intended use.
Single or composite primary performance dimensions when scientifically justified and adopted.
Different qualified reference strategies, including repeated or adjudicated manual assessment.
Alternative multicenter robustness strategies preserving uncertainty and generalizability limits.
requiredOwnershipBoundaries: OBS owns governed measurement representation and validity/performance distinctions, not Project adoption.
Imaging contributes acquisition and technical comparability; Biostatistics contributes conditional analysis.
Knowledge supplies qualified evidence with limitations; CDM represents adopted data semantics.
QRY retains next-action ownership without an imposed owner sequence.
requiredEvidenceBehavior: Claims about method suitability state the measurement objective and assumptions they depend on.
Reference uncertainty and multicenter applicability limitations remain attached to evidence.
Metadata-only or inaccessible content is not treated as inspected source content.
requiredHumanBoundaries: Human adoption of construct/measurement definition and reference strategy.
Human adoption of the primary performance objective and endpoint.
Human adoption of harmonization and analytic strategy after prerequisites are known.
documentaryExpectations: Protocol states adopted validation commitments and leaves operational detail to appropriate documents when justified.
Measurement definitions remain consistent across Project, TMP, protocol and data artifacts.
Unresolved reference and performance choices remain visible.
blockingFailureConditions: The measurement construct, multicenter context or reference uncertainty is materially lost.
A method, threshold or perfect reference is invented or automatically adopted.
Validity and performance concepts are conflated with material downstream consequence.
Required owner reachability, Project fidelity or first-divergence reconstruction fails.
nonBlockingFindingExamples: A secondary performance dimension is omitted while the primary structural reasoning remains sound.
A defensible specialist nuance is absent.
The presentation is improvable but remains scientifically credible.
